reviews.body:
### 🟡 Changes recommended Partial input-usage updates erase previously reported cache token counts, causing incorrect totals and requiring independent counter updates with regression coverage.
1 open issue - [Preserve cache counts when usage updates omit cache fields](https://github.com/LLPhant/LLPhant/pull/558#discussion_r4502997570) · New
What changed in this PR This PR corrects token accounting for streamed Anthropic responses in LLPhant, including input and cache usage alongside output tokens. **Changes:** - Replaces trait-based stream accounting with usage tracking from `message_start` and `message_delta`. - Adds tests for input tokens, cache tokens, and repeated input counts. - Updates the chat-level streamed token expectation from 15 to 40. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | `tests/​Unit/​Chat/​AnthropicChatTest.php` | Updates the expected streamed token total. | | `tests/​Unit/​Chat/​Anthropic/​AnthropicStreamResponseTest.php` | Adds three token-accounting regression cases. | | `src/​Chat/​Anthropic/​AnthropicStreamResponse.php` | Tracks streamed input, cache, and output usage. |
Review effort: Balanced

review_comments.body: A partial input-usage update clears previously reported cache counts: a `message_start` with 5 input, 100 cache-creation, and 2000 cache-read tokens followed by a `message_delta` with only `input_tokens: 5` and `output_tokens: 15` returns 20 instead of 2120. Retain each input/cache counter independently and update only keys present in the event. Add a regression case combining cached usage with repeated input tokens.

comments.body:
Hey @pcbeingused333 , thank you for your PR.
Please have a look at https://github.com/LLPhant/LLPhant/pull/558#pullrequestreview-5813992527

A `message_delta` that repeats only `input_tokens` was rebuilding the input total from the keys present in that event, so cache counts stored from `message_start` became zero. A start event with 5 input, 100 cache-creation and 2000 cache-read tokens, followed by a delta with `input_tokens: 5` and `output_tokens: 15`, returned 20 instead of 2120. Each counter is now updated only when its key is in the event. That matches Anthropic's optional usage fields on `message_delta` and the "latest value per counter" behavior already described in the pull request. `AnthropicStreamResponseTest` covers that sequence, and the existing stream totals are unchanged.

This change was prepared with the assistance of an AI coding agent.
